alertRules.name: CEI Pattern Violation - Potential Reentrancy
alertRules.description: Function has external calls after state modifications, violating Checks-Effects-Interactions pattern. This is a strong indicator of potential reentrancy vulnerability.
alertRules.mitigation: Reorder operations to perform all external calls after all state updates, or use reentrancy guards.

alertRules.name: Missing Access Control on State-Changing Function
alertRules.description: Public/external function modifies state but lacks explicit access control modifier.
alertRules.mitigation: Add appropriate access control modifiers based on intended permissions.

alertRules.name: DelegateCall Detected - Execution Context Forwarding
alertRules.description: Function uses delegatecall which forwards execution context including storage. Malicious target contract can compromise entire contract.
alertRules.mitigation: Ensure delegatecall target is trusted, immutable, or governed by robust access control.

alertRules.name: Unbounded Loop - Potential DoS Risk
alertRules.description: Function contains loop that may iterate over unbounded data structures. Could exceed block gas limit with sufficient data.
alertRules.mitigation: Add iteration limits, use pagination, or move loop logic off-chain.

alertRules.name: Oracle Price Deviation Exceeds Threshold
alertRules.description: Observed oracle price deviates more than 5% from expected/TWAP price. Possible manipulation attempt.
alertRules.mitigation: Use TWAP oracles, implement circuit breakers, add flash loan detection.

alertRules.name: Accounting Invariant Violation: Total supply accounting must balance...

alertRules.mitigation: Review transaction that caused accounting inconsistency. May indicate fund leakage or calculation error.

alertRules.name: Unusual Gas Consumption Pattern
alertRules.description: Transaction consumed unusually high percentage of gas limit. Could indicate griefing attack or infinite loop.
alertRules.mitigation: Monitor for repeated high-gas transactions from same address.

alertRules.name: External Call Failed Silently
alertRules.description: External call returned false but execution continued. May lead to inconsistent state.
alertRules.mitigation: Check return values of external calls and revert on failure.

alertRules.name: Timestamp-Dependent Logic Detected
alertRules.description: Function uses block.timestamp for critical logic. Miners can manipulate this value slightly.
alertRules.mitigation: Avoid timestamp dependency for critical calculations or use wider time windows.
